claims.claim_ar: نداء مباشر بالمخاطبة بـ «يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا» كالتفات يخاطب فئة المؤمنين ويشدّ الانتباه إلى الخطاب.
claims.claim_en: Direct vocative address using «يا أيها الذين آمنوا» — an iltifat (shift/turn) that addresses the community of believers and focuses attention on the following injunction.

claims.claim_ar: توكيد بلاغي بواسطة لام الوقوع المتبوعة بزيادة التأكيد (نّ) في صيغة فعلية («لَـ» + فعل + نّ) للدلالة على الثبوت واليقين ـ هنا يوازيها في الآية بناء «لَيَبْلُوَنَّكُمُ».
claims.claim_en: Rhetorical emphasis using the emphatic prepositional/affixal لَ (lam) combined with emphatic augmentation (nun/shaddah) on the verb («لَ» + verb + «نّ») to convey certainty — pattern exemplified by «لَيَمَسَّنَّ ...» and parallel to the form «لَيَبْلُوَنَّكُمُ» in the target verse.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited source substring shows the same morphological emphatic pattern on a different verb («لَيَمَسَّنَّ»). Applying the same rhetorical label to «لَيَبْلُوَنَّكُمُ» is a generalization based on parallel morphology and classical commentary; verify with a balagha source explicitly discussing this exact verb-form in S5:94.

warnings: The available source chunks are general iʻrāb/exegetical fragments and examples from other verses; quoted substrings are taken from those chunks to illustrate parallel rhetorical patterns rather than from a balagha commentary that explicitly analyzes S5:94.

Some claims (notably the emphatic-lam claim) are inferred from morphological-parallel examples in the provided chunks. They should be reviewed against classical balagha works (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti or tafsir balagha) that explicitly discuss S5:94 to confirm the rhetorical reading.
